kjv: Whither have ye (David) made a road to day?
note: Hebrew pashat means to make a raid; "road" in 1611 meant an inroad or raid, which a modern reader takes as a highway.

kjv: and so [will be] his (David's) manner all the while he dwelleth
mine: Such was his (David's) practice all the time he lived
note: The clause wekoh mishpato (no verb) can continue the feared report or be the narrator's comment on David's habitual practice; the past-tense "all the days he lived" favours the narrator.
